name: Chimpanzee Taggers
summary:
CHIMPANZEE TAGGERS

Swing, run, and scale your way to victory in Chimpanzee Taggers, the ultimate fast-paced physics-based multiplayer tag game! Created by 4ever, this game takes high-speed chase mechanics to the next level with incredibly smooth locomotion, customizable lobbies, and non-stop action.

🌟 GAME FEATURES:

CLASSIC LOCOMOTION: Master the iconic physics-based movement where your arms are your only tools to climb, jump, and escape other players.
